ns2:section.sectionText: Fundamental concepts of entrepreneurship and commercialization of new technology in new and existing engineering and high-tech businesses. Guest speaker topics vary, but typically include: evaluation of technologies and business ideas in general; commercializing new technologies; financing through private and public sources; legal issues; product development; marketing; international business issues. Same as TE 460. Credit is not given for both ENG 360 and ENG 460. Meets in 301 CSL.
